description: This file contains code for loading, configuring, and benchmarking various GPT models, including functions for different quantization modes and experiments, with references to external modules and configurations related to model setup and performance measurement.

classes.name: GPTModelConfig
classes.description: Dataclass for storing configuration parameters of GPT models, including name, module, mode, quantizer, performance metrics, and optional batch size.

methods.name: device_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the device if CUDA is used, or passes if CPU.

methods.name: get_arch_name
methods.description: Returns the device architecture name, either GPU model or platform machine type.

methods.name: multinomial_sample_one_no_sync
methods.description: Samples one index from a probability distribution without CUDA synchronization.

methods.name: logits_to_probs
methods.description: Converts logits to probabilities with optional top-k filtering.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Samples the next token index and probabilities from logits.

methods.name: prefill
methods.description: Generates initial logits and samples tokens for model input.

methods.name: decode_one_token
methods.description: Decodes a single token from the model given input tensors.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a sequence of tokens from the model given a prompt.

methods.name: _load_model
methods.description: Loads and initializes a model based on configuration, with optional quantization.

methods.name: _get_model_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of the model in bytes, considering only active parameters and buffers.

methods.name: run_experiment
methods.description: Runs performance benchmarking on a specified GPT model configuration, measuring tokens/sec, bandwidth, and compilation time.
